answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, after Semaphore membership proofs establish eligibility, evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed shares encode a rate limit. A duplicate message in the same epoch produces two openings for one RLN identity, enabling Shamir reconstruction of its private key; the contract verifies the polynomial identity commitment and instantly slashes collateral. Thus lotus, zenith, and echo remain sybil-resistant labels, not additional identities.
